def: A parameter passed by reference: the procedure works on the caller's original variable, so changes to it are passed back.
quote: PROCEDURE Mod_X(T4 : INTEGER, BYREF P3 : REAL)
note: 调用时把变量本身交给模块,模块里改了它,调用者那边的变量也跟着变。

zh: 全局变量 / 局部变量(作用域)
def: A global variable is declared outside any module and can be used anywhere in the program; a local variable is declared inside a module and can only be used there.
quote: The programmer has decided to use the following global variables:
note: 全局变量在所有模块之外声明,哪里都能用;局部变量在模块里声明,只在这个模块里存在,模块结束就消失。

zh: 记录(自定义复合数据类型)
def: A data structure that groups items (fields) of different data types under a single identifier, declared with TYPE ... ENDTYPE.
quote: The data will be held in a record structure of type Employee.
note: 自己定义的类型,把几个不同类型的数据项(字段)放在一个名字下面,比如一个员工的编号、姓名、出勤率。

def: A data type with only two values, TRUE or FALSE.
quote: (ii) Give an example of when a variable of type Boolean would be used.
note: 只有 TRUE 和 FALSE 两个值的数据类型。

def: A Boolean variable set to TRUE or FALSE to record whether a condition has occurred, for example to end a loop.
quote: 'NoSwap' mechanism: Set flag in inner loop to indicate swap
note: 一个布尔变量,用来记住某件事有没有发生过,比如冒泡排序里这一轮有没有交换。

def: A collection of data together with the operations that can be performed on it, defined independently of how it is implemented.
quote: The following diagram represents an Abstract Data Type (ADT) for a linked list.
note: 只规定存什么数据、能做哪些操作(加入、取出、查找),不规定怎么实现;栈、队列、链表都是。

def: Joining two or more strings together into one string using the & operator.
quote: The module will concatenate a single character to the end of BitString by applying one of the two rules
note: 把两个字符串首尾接成一个,伪代码用 & 运算符。

def: A diagram of states (circles) and transitions (arrows) labelled with input and output, showing how a system changes.
note: 用圆圈表示状态、箭头表示转换,箭头上写触发转换的输入(以及输出),题目一般要你按输入序列走出最终状态。

def: Manually stepping through the code with test data, recording variable values, without running it on a computer.
quote: (b) Complete the trace table below by dry running the procedure Encode() when the following values are input
note: 不上机运行,拿着测试数据一行一行手动执行代码,把每个变量的值记到 trace table 里。

zh: 前置条件循环 / 后置条件循环
def: A pre-condition loop (WHILE … ENDWHILE) tests its condition before each pass, so may run zero times; a post-condition loop (REPEAT … UNTIL) tests after, so runs at least once.
quote: (b) The pseudocode for Convert() contains a conditional loop.
note: 条件循环,次数事先不知道。前置条件(WHILE)先判断再执行,可能一次都不执行;后置条件(REPEAT … UNTIL)先执行再判断,至少执行一次。

def: READ opens a file to read from; WRITE overwrites or creates a file; APPEND adds new lines to the end of an existing file.
quote: (iii) Explain why WRITE mode cannot be used in the answer to **part 2(a)(i)**. [1]
note: OPENFILE 时选的模式:READ 只读;WRITE 新建或覆盖原有内容;APPEND 在原文件末尾接着写。

def: Repeating a block of code, using a loop such as FOR, WHILE or REPEAT.
quote: (b) Each pseudocode statement in the following table contains an example of selection, assignment or iteration.
note: 三种基本结构之一,意思就是循环:FOR、WHILE、REPEAT。

def: A special character placed between data values to mark where one value ends and the next begins.
quote: The data for each rejected part forms a data packet made up of three data items, each separated by the ‘/’ character delimiter.
note: 放在数据项之间、标出一项在哪里结束的特殊字符,比如 '/' 或逗号;它本身不是数据。

def: A value passed into a module (procedure or function) when it is called, declared in the module header.
quote: • Called with parameters LoanID and BookID
note: 调用模块时传进去的值,在模块头里写明名字和类型。

def: Choosing which code to run depending on a condition, using IF or CASE statements (including OTHERWISE).
quote: (b) Each pseudocode statement in the following table contains an example of selection, assignment or iteration.
note: 三种基本结构之一,意思是根据条件选择执行哪段代码:IF 和 CASE。

def: A module that returns a value to the calling program (FUNCTION … RETURNS); a procedure does not return a value.
note: 调用后返回一个值的模块(FUNCTION … RETURNS);不返回值的叫过程。

def: The name given to a variable, constant, array, procedure or function in a program.
note: 就是名字:变量、常量、数组、过程、函数的名字都叫标识符。

def: A pointer value in the last node showing there are no further nodes in the list.
quote: The symbol Ø represents a null pointer.
note: 链表最后一个节点的指针取的特殊值,表示后面没有节点了。

def: PUSH adds an item to the top of the stack; POP removes the item at the top; the top-of-stack pointer is updated each time.
quote: The memory location pointed to by TopOfStack if three POP operations are performed.
note: 栈的两个操作:PUSH 把数据放到栈顶,POP 取走栈顶的数据,栈顶指针跟着移动。

def: The data type for numbers that can have a fractional part, such as an average or a sum of money.
quote: Returns a REAL (which is the value of the fine to be paid in the case of an overdue loan)
note: 可以带小数部分的数,比如平均值、金额;只存整数用 INTEGER。

zh: 分解(把问题拆成子问题)
def: Breaking a complex problem down into smaller sub-problems that are easier to understand, program, test and solve separately.
quote: (a) Decomposition will be used to break the problem down into sub-problems.
note: 把一个复杂的问题拆成几个较小、容易解决的子问题,每个子问题再分别设计成模块。

def: Software for writing, running and debugging code, with tools such as an editor, breakpoints, single-stepping and a watch window.
quote: (a) A programmer is testing a program using an Integrated Development Environment (IDE).
note: 写代码、运行、调试用的一整套软件,包含编辑器、断点、单步执行、变量监视等工具。

def: A pre-written, tested routine (function or procedure) stored in a library that a programmer can call instead of writing the code.
quote: (iii) One other way that can reduce the risk of errors when writing the program is the use of library routines.
note: 别人事先写好并测试过、放在库里的过程或函数,程序里直接调用,不用自己再写。好处是节省时间、错误少;缺点是不一定完全符合需求、可能有你不知道的问题。

en: normal / abnormal / boundary / extreme test data
zh: 正常 / 异常 / 边界 / 极端测试数据
def: Normal: valid data that should be accepted; abnormal (erroneous): invalid data that should be rejected; boundary / extreme: values at the limits of the valid range, and just outside them.
quote: Type of test data | Test data value | Expected outcome
note: 四类测试数据:normal 是正常、应被接受的值;abnormal(erroneous)是非法、应被拒绝的值;boundary 是可接受范围两端以及紧挨着的不可接受值;extreme 是可接受范围的最大最小值。

def: An automatic check that data is reasonable and acceptable, such as a range check or a length check.
quote: (d) A validation function is written to check that the passwords generated are valid.
note: 程序自动检查输入是否合理、是否符合规则(范围、长度、格式),不能保证数据正确,只能保证合理。

def: Filtering out unnecessary details and keeping only the essential information needed to solve the problem.
quote: The process of abstraction has been used when designing the new module.
note: 去掉解题不需要的细节,只保留必需的信息。

def: A queue in a fixed array where the pointers wrap round to location 0 after the last location, so freed locations are reused.
quote: (b) A programmer designs a circular queue. - The data items are stored in a 1D array, MyQueue - The queue is managed using two pointers.
note: 用固定长度的数组做队列,指针走到数组末尾后回到开头继续用,这样前面空出来的位置可以重复使用。

def: A loop that repeats a set number of times, used when the number of iterations is known in advance.
quote: Loop structure: A count-controlled loop Justification: The number of iterations is known
note: 执行次数事先知道的循环,就是 FOR … NEXT。

zh: 文件结束(判断是否读完)
def: EOF(file) returns TRUE when the end of the file has been reached and there are no more lines to read.
quote: Set up a conditional loop, repeating until the value is found or the EOF() is reached
note: EOF(文件名) 在文件已经读完、没有下一行时返回 TRUE,读文件的循环用它来结束。

def: A linked list of unused nodes; a new node is taken from the front of it, and its start (next free) pointer moves on.
quote: The free list is as follows: Diagram: free list, drawn left to right.
note: 链表实现里,把所有未使用的节点也串成一个链表;加入新数据时从空闲链表头部拿一个节点,删除的节点放回空闲链表。

def: MOD gives the remainder after integer division (9 MOD 4 = 1); DIV gives the whole-number quotient (9 DIV 4 = 2).
note: MOD 取余数(27 MOD 3 = 0,9 MOD 4 = 1);DIV 取整数商(9 DIV 4 = 2)。

zh: 报告窗口 / 监视窗口
def: An IDE window that displays the current values of chosen variables while the program runs or is stepped through.
quote: The programmer interrupts its execution; the TimeSoFar is shown in a report window as 125 (the cleaning time so far in seconds).
note: IDE 里的一个窗口,程序运行或暂停时显示所选变量的当前值。

def: Repeatedly breaking an algorithm into more detailed steps until each step can be written as pseudocode.
quote: Apply the process of stepwise refinement to increase the detail of the algorithm.
note: 把算法的每一步反复拆成更详细的小步,直到每一步都能直接写成代码。

def: A mistake in the grammar of the programming language, which prevents the program from being translated or run.
note: 代码不符合语言的语法规则(拼错关键字、少括号),程序无法编译或解释。

def: Testing by a small group of real users before release, to find remaining errors and give feedback.
quote: (b) Alpha and beta testing has been completed.
note: 软件基本完成后,交给一小部分真实用户试用,收集反馈、找剩下的错误。

def: Parameter passed by value: a copy of the value is given to the module, so changes inside do not affect the caller's variable.
quote: PROCEDURE Initialise(BYREF ID : INTEGER, BYVAL CC : INTEGER)
note: 调用时只把值复制一份交给模块,模块里怎么改都不影响调用者的变量。

def: One element of a linked list, consisting of a data field and a pointer field.
quote: Linked list (each node has a data field and a pointer field):
note: 链表中的一个元素,由数据部分和指向下一个节点的指针组成。

def: A named module that carries out a task when called and does not return a value.
quote: Some of the modules in the structure chart are functions, others are procedures.
note: 执行一项任务、不返回值的模块。

def: A simple dummy module replaces an unfinished module, returning an expected value or outputting a message to show it was called.
quote: The program is to be tested using stub testing before all the program modules have been completed.
note: 某个模块还没写好时,先用一个只输出一句提示或返回固定值的简单模块代替它,用来测试调用它的部分。

def: Maintenance to change the program to meet new requirements, technology or legislation.
quote: (b) The program has been in use for a number of months and adaptive maintenance is required.
note: 程序本身没错,但需求、硬件、法规等外部情况变了,程序要跟着改。

def: A sort that repeatedly compares adjacent items and swaps them if out of order; an efficient version stops when no swaps occur and shrinks the boundary.
quote: A procedure Sort() is needed to sort Result into ascending order of mark using an efficient bubble sort algorithm.
note: 反复比较相邻的两个元素,顺序不对就交换;某一轮没有任何交换就说明已经排好,可以提前结束。

zh: 先进先出 / 先进后出
def: FIFO (a queue): the first item added is the first removed. FILO, also called LIFO (a stack): the last item added is the first removed.
quote: MP1 First value added to queue is the first value removed // FIFO // LILO
note: FIFO 先进先出,是队列的规则;FILO(也写作 LIFO)先进后出,是栈的规则。

def: The first line of a procedure or function: name, parameters with their types (the interface through which data is passed) and, for a function, RETURNS and the return type.
quote: (ii) Write the pseudocode module headers for Sub-A and Sub-B.
note: 模块的第一行:名字、参数(名字、类型、顺序、BYREF 或 BYVAL)和函数的返回类型。调用者靠这个接口传数据,不是屏幕界面。

def: A life cycle model using quick prototypes, constant user involvement and minimal planning, so requirements changes are easily made.
quote: (c) The program will be developed using the Rapid Application Development (RAD) life cycle.
note: 一种开发模型:很少前期规划,快速做出原型给用户看,根据反馈不断修改,用户全程参与。

def: A special value that cannot be real data, used to show an element is unused or that input has ended, e.g. -1.
quote: Output the total number of integers greater than 120 after the –1 terminator is input.
note: 一个不可能是真实数据的特殊值(比如 -1 或 99999),用来表示输入结束或数组元素未使用。

def: Testing a module by giving inputs and checking outputs against expected results, without looking at the code.
quote: The FormatName() procedure has been written in a programming language and is to be tested using the black-box method.
note: 只看输入和输出,不看代码内部,用测试数据对照期望结果。

def: Maintenance to find and fix bugs where the program does not work as expected.
quote: CORRECTIVE maintenance has to be carried out.
note: 程序有 bug、运行结果不对,找出并改正错误。

def: Accessing a field of a record using the record name, a dot and the field name, e.g. Batch[ThisIndex].Weight.
note: 访问记录里某个字段的写法:记录名.字段名,比如 Item[1].Stage。

def: Enqueue adds an item at the rear of the queue; dequeue removes the item at the front of the queue.
note: 队列的两个操作:enqueue 从队尾加入,dequeue 从队头取出。

def: The value in square brackets that identifies the position of an element within an array.
quote: The name of the variable used as an array index
note: 方括号里那个指出第几个元素的值,比如 Data[5] 的 5。

def: A named, self-contained block of code (a procedure or function) that performs a specific task and can be called from several places.
quote: Part of the algorithm would be appropriate to implement as a subroutine (a procedure or a function).
note: 过程和函数的统称:有名字、独立的一段代码,完成一项任务,可以多次调用。

def: A testing method where the code is followed step by step by hand using a test plan with test data and expected outputs.
quote: (a) The program will be tested using the walkthrough method.
note: 一种测试方法:几个人一起拿着测试数据把代码从头到尾手动走一遍,找出错误。

def: A linear life cycle model in which each stage is completed and its result passed to the next stage, with return to an earlier stage possible.
quote: The following diagram shows the incomplete waterfall model of the program development life cycle.
note: 一种开发模型:分析、设计、编码、测试、维护按顺序进行,上一阶段完成后结果交给下一阶段,一般不回头。

def: Testing of the completed software by the developer's own staff in-house before it is released to the customer.
quote: (c) During the alpha testing stage, an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) is used to help locate an error that has been identified.
note: 软件完成后在公司内部、由开发方自己的人员进行的测试,在交给外部用户之前。

zh: 字母数字(字母和数字组成)
def: Made up of letters (a-z, A-Z) and digits (0-9) only.
quote: The password will be of a fixed format, consisting of three groups of four alphanumeric characters.
note: 只由字母和数字组成。

def: Upper-case and lower-case letters are treated as different, so 'a' is not the same as 'A'.
quote: To be valid, each password must: - be 14 characters long - be organised as three groups of four case-sensitive alphanumeric characters.
note: 区分大小写,'a' 和 'A' 算两个不同的字符。

def: One named data item within a record or within a line of a file.
quote: Each line of a text file contains data organised into fixed-length fields as shown:
note: 记录里的一个数据项,或者文件一行里的一段数据。

def: The smallest and largest index values of an array dimension, written ARRAY[lower:upper] in the declaration.
quote: The lower and upper bound values are shown in the table:
note: 数组下标能取的最小值和最大值,ARRAY[1:10] 中的 1 和 10;不是数组里存的数据的范围。

def: Maintenance that improves the performance or efficiency of a working program.
quote: Some time later, changes are made to the program to improve the speed of response.
note: 程序没有错、需求也没变,只是改得更好,比如更快、更好用。

def: A programming construct in which statements are executed one after another in the order they are written.
note: 三种基本结构之一,意思是语句按书写顺序一条接一条执行。

def: A character set in which each character has a numeric code, e.g. 'A' = 65, 'a' = 97, '0' = 48.
quote: For reference, relevant ASCII values are as follows:
note: 一种字符编码,每个字符对应一个数字,比如 'A' 是 65,'a' 是 97。

def: Storing a value in a variable using the ← operator; INPUT also assigns a value.
quote: (b) Each pseudocode statement in the following table contains an example of selection, assignment or iteration.
note: 把一个值存进变量,伪代码用 ←。

def: An extra digit calculated from the other digits of a number and appended to it, so errors in input can be detected.
quote: Students are learning about a simple check digit method for data validation.
note: 根据其他各位数字算出来、附加在号码末尾的一位,输入后重新计算比对,用来发现输错的数字。

def: A data type built from other data types, such as a record containing an INTEGER and a STRING.
quote: a new (composite) data type / record is defined (that consists of both INTEGER and STRING)
note: 由其他数据类型组合出来的类型,比如一个记录里既有 INTEGER 字段也有 STRING 字段。

def: Problem-solving skills used to design programs, including abstraction, decomposition and algorithm design.
quote: (b) Identify the computational thinking skill that you needed to use to answer part (a). [1]
note: 设计程序时用到的思考方法的总称,包括抽象、分解、模式识别、算法设计。

def: An IDE feature that offers suggestions or help relevant to the code currently being typed.
quote: an Integrated Development Environment (IDE) provides context-sensitive help such as 'auto-complete'
note: IDE 根据当前正在输入的代码,提示可用的关键字、变量名或参数。

def: An investigation at the start of a project to decide whether the proposed system is practical, affordable and worthwhile to develop.
quote: (a) The analysis stage included a feasibility study.
note: 项目开始阶段的调查,判断这个系统在技术、成本、时间上是否值得做、做得成。

def: Storage that keeps its data when the program ends or the power is switched off, such as a text file on secondary storage.
quote: The data is retained when the program is terminated / after the computer is switched off // data is stored permanently // non-volatile storage
note: 程序结束或断电后数据仍然保留的存储,比如保存到文件里。

def: A person or group with an interest in the program, such as the customer, client or user.
quote: Needs high involvement/feedback of the stake holders /customer / client
note: 和这个程序有利害关系的人,比如客户、用户、出资方。

def: A naming style where words are joined without spaces and each new word starts with a capital letter, e.g. ItemPostalCost.
quote: Sensible / meaningful variable names // use of Camel Case
note: 多个单词连写、从第二个单词起首字母大写的命名方式,比如 TotalScore 或 totalScore。

def: A data structure whose size can change while the program runs, as items are added or removed.
note: 程序运行时大小可以随数据增减而改变的数据结构;数组是固定大小的静态结构。

def: An IDE feature that checks syntax as the code is typed and highlights errors immediately.
note: IDE 在你输入代码的同时检查语法,立刻标出错误,不用等到编译。

def: A check where an extra bit is added to binary data so the total number of 1s is always even (or always odd).
quote: A module Parity() takes a string as a parameter.
note: 奇偶校验:在二进制数据后加一位,使 1 的总个数保持为偶数(偶校验)或奇数(奇校验)。

def: An IDE feature that automatically lays out code with indentation and highlighting of keywords and structures to make it easier to read.
note: IDE 自动排版代码:自动缩进,用不同颜色显示关键字。

def: Testing based on knowledge of the code's internal structure, designing tests so that every path through the program is executed.
quote: (i) The module is tested using white-box testing.
note: 根据代码内部的结构设计测试数据,让每一条路径、每一个分支都被执行到。
